lines.zh: 我用四条腿走，蹄下带出蓝屑
lines.en: I walk on four legs, blue flakes under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我的身上是青金石的颜色
lines.en: I am the color of lapis.

lines.zh: 每走一步，就落一点蓝粉
lines.en: Each step drops a little blue dust.

lines.zh: 我走过草地，草上留下蓝色
lines.en: I cross the grass and leave blue behind.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛是深蓝的，像夜
lines.en: My mane is deep blue, like night.
I do not eat grass; I only walk.

lines.zh: 我关节里有细小的石头响
lines.en: Small stones click inside my joints.

lines.zh: 骑手指向哪里，我就去哪
lines.en: Where the rider points, I go.
I leave shallow pits in the mud.
My shadow has a blue cast.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，四蹄对得很齐
lines.en: I walk steadily, four hooves aligned.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片碎石，声音很脆
lines.en: I walk over gravel, a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 我身上有灵魂沙的暗纹
lines.en: Dark soul-sand veins run through me.

lines.zh: 我走到光里，身上有蓝色的亮点
lines.en: In the light, blue specks shine on me.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一块青金石雕的马
lines.en: I stand like a horse carved from lapis.
Blue dust settles at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两个发蓝的凹坑
lines.en: My eyes are two blue hollows.
I need no feed.

lines.zh: 风把我的表面吹得更亮
lines.en: The wind polishes my surface.
I wait for a hand on the saddle.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴僵着，垂不下去
lines.en: My tail is stiff and will not drop.
I smell clay.
A slight tremor in the ground.

lines.zh: 我是捏出来的，不是生的
lines.en: I was shaped, not born.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下来的粉是蓝的
lines.en: The dust I shed is blue.
I keep still; moving wears the color off.
A shallow crack runs along my flank.

lines.zh: 我这一身，比石头更像石头
lines.en: This body is more stone than stone.

lines.zh: 阳光照了半天，我也不暖
lines.en: Hours of sun, and I am not warm.

lines.zh: 我在等骑手的手放上来
lines.en: I wait for a rider's hand.

lines.zh: 我转过头，蓝粉撒了一点
lines.en: I turn my head, scattering blue dust.
I know you are looking at my color.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，我只是站着
lines.en: I mean no harm; I merely stand.
My rider is gone; I do not move.

lines.zh: 你伸手摸我，会沾上蓝粉
lines.en: Touch me and blue dust will stain you.
I step back, lightly.

lines.zh: 你身上没有灵魂沙的味道
lines.en: You do not smell of soul sand.
All four hooves take the ground.

lines.zh: 蓝粉从鬃毛上落到你手背
lines.en: Blue dust falls from my mane onto the back of your hand
Something on you shines.

lines.zh: 我没有点头，我只转脖子
lines.en: I do not nod; I only turn my neck.
Do you mean to ride me?
I must know you first.
My blue shows clearly in the light.

lines.zh: 我被砸掉一角，蓝粉撒开
lines.en: A corner is knocked off; blue dust scatters.
The crack has travelled further.

lines.zh: 我发不出声，只能晃一晃
lines.en: I cannot make a sound; I only sway.
One leg is shorter.
I give half a step, hooves grinding.
That made me lighter.

lines.zh: 里面的灵魂沙露出来了
lines.en: The soul sand inside shows through.
These legs still hold.
Once the joints loosen, my steps go crooked.
Two more and I scatter.
I do not eat; that is for living things.
Give it and I could not digest it.
This is not hard enough.

lines.zh: 你把砂砾放下，我会踩过去
lines.en: Lay gravel down and I will walk over it.
I prefer lapis.
My mouth is stone; I taste nothing.
Only blue things catch my eye.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，又继续站着
lines.en: I pause, and stand again.
I am not a thing to be fed.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，蓝色的粉飞了
lines.en: You hit me and blue dust flies.
This body can hold you down.

lines.zh: 这一下磕掉我一角，是蓝的
lines.en: That chipped off a corner, and it was blue.
I back two steps, hooves scraping.
We collide with a porcelain sound.

lines.zh: 我没有疼，只是掉了一点
lines.en: I feel no pain, only loss.
I set my four legs straight again.
You are stained blue now.
That rubbed the color off me.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我仍是这副样子
lines.en: Another impact, and I am still this shape.

lines.zh: 我们是被捏出来的，不会成对
lines.en: We are shaped, not bred; we do not pair.

lines.zh: 两匹马站在一起，蓝得一样
lines.en: Two horses side by side, the same blue.
All we need are riders.

lines.zh: 并排站着，影子合成一块
lines.en: Standing abreast, our shadows merge.

lines.zh: 谁先碎，另一个就替它站着
lines.en: Whichever crumbles, the other stands in its place.

lines.zh: 石头不说话，我们也不说
lines.en: Stone does not speak; neither do we.
Same clay, same blue.

lines.zh: 一起走的时候，蓝粉落得更多
lines.en: Walking together we shed more blue.

lines.zh: 我们的距离正好，不多不少
lines.en: Our spacing is exact.
Then let us wait together.

lines.zh: 我叼不住，我的嘴是石头
lines.en: I cannot hold it; my mouth is stone.
I nudge it with my muzzle.
It rolls away from my hooves.
I step on it, and it breaks.
I have no hands; I can only lower my neck.
It is stained with blue dust now.

lines.zh: 我用前蹄把它刨到石堆后
lines.en: I scrape it behind the stone pile with a forehoof

lines.zh: 这一点重量，我没有感觉
lines.en: This weight means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我推着它往前走了一段
lines.en: I push it along a stretch.
A moving shape ahead.
I turn that way.

lines.zh: 地上的震动告诉我距离
lines.en: Tremors tell me the distance.
Were I ridden, I would have charged.
I have no throat to shout with.
I have quickened my pace.
An open stretch on this line.
Blue dust trails behind me.
I sink my neck low.
My hooves scrape the ground.
I have picked that one out.
I will run until I break apart.
I close in step by step.
It skirts a stone; I pass beside it.
I am not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 蓝粉把我经过的路画出来了
lines.en: Blue dust draws the path I take.

lines.zh: 它退到坡下，那里不好站
lines.en: It backs downhill; poor footing there.
My joints are not holding well.
Another stretch and I arrive.
It tires first; I do not tire.
At the last, I check my stride.
I lower my head and aim.
The ground hums low.
It glanced back once.
A layer of blue sloughs off me.
I lift a forehoof and bring it down.

lines.zh: 这一下只有重量，没有技巧
lines.en: Only weight, no skill.
After the hit, a corner falls off.
You are shoved back three steps.
This head of mine is one piece of stone.

lines.zh: 我甩头，蓝粉撒了你一脸
lines.en: I toss my head; blue dust hits your face.
I back off and reset.
That used everything I have.
I can fight until I break.

lines.zh: 一堆青金石色立起来，成了马形
lines.en: A heap of lapis blue rises into horse shape.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙的纹在我身上走
lines.en: Soul-sand veins creep across me.

lines.zh: 我落地时，脚边一圈蓝粉
lines.en: When I land, a ring of blue dust.
I need no breath, only to stand.

lines.zh: 我是被捏成这个样子的
lines.en: I was shaped into this form.

lines.zh: 鬃毛还是湿的，颜色很深
lines.en: My mane is still wet, the color deep.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，我能感觉到
lines.en: Someone is near; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我第一次动，关节咔了一下
lines.en: On my first move, a joint clicks.
I lift my forelegs and brace.

lines.zh: 我身上有手指按过的痕
lines.en: Fingerprints remain on me.
I wait here for a rider.

lines.zh: 蓝色的粉从我背上滚下来
lines.en: Blue dust rolls off my back.

lines.zh: 我朝空地中央走了几步
lines.en: I walk a few steps to the middle.
I stop and wait for the first rider.

lines.zh: 我的蹄下压出一片蓝印
lines.en: My hooves press blue marks into the ground.

lines.zh: 地表裂了一点，我踩了进去
lines.en: The ground cracks and my hoof sinks in.

lines.zh: 火烤着我，蓝色烧成了黑
lines.en: Fire bakes me, and the blue burns black.
I hit the ground and break into pieces.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的缝，我变重了
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams; I grow heavy.
The blast blows half of me apart.

lines.zh: 一块石头打在我身上，留下坑
lines.en: A stone hits me, leaving a pit.

lines.zh: 那股力在我身上压实了
lines.en: That force packs me tighter.
Stone has no need to feed.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，蓝光炸开
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; blue light bursts.

lines.zh: 没有地面托着，我碎在空中
lines.en: Nothing holds me up; I break in midair.
